subject: SwiftCommerce: unexpected inference surge — handoff, mitigations, and closure plan
messages:
From: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@swiftcommerce.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: oncall@swiftcommerce.com, pm@swiftcommerce.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden latency spike across inference endpoints (prod)

Hi Aditya —

We started seeing a dramatic increase in 5xxs and p95 latency across all inference endpoints for our main checkout flows starting ~07:50 PT. Errors began at 07:50 and peaked at ~08:05; traffic is back to baseline now but the business impact was material (users dropped off the checkout).

Attached is a screenshot from our synthetic runner and a slice of logs. Can Redwood share an initial root-cause hypothesis and immediate mitigation steps? We need an exec readout for leadership at 11:00 PT.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Jensen
Head of Platform Reliability, SwiftCommerce

Attachment: swift-synth-checkout-20270518.png (png)
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, alice.jensen@swiftcommerce.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:31:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Sudden latency spike across inference endpoints (prod)

Thanks Alice — looping in ops and engineering. Quick timeline and immediate asks:

- Observed: increased p95 latency and ~4% 5xx rate across the US cluster between 07:50–08:15 PT.
- Customer impact: checkout timeouts and increased cart abandonment (~3.8% conversion hit in the window).
- Immediate mitigation underway: Marcus is toggling conservative batching and temporarily routing high-latency routes to a warmed backup pool.

Planned 30-minute exec-ready notes: root-cause hypothesis, mitigation status, customer impact metrics, and next steps (RCA delivery timeline). Grace — can you own the exec readout? Marcus — update me with mitigation progress and any rollback triggers.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Lead, Priority Customers — Redwood Inference

[Attachment: swift-20270518-latency-sparkline.png (png) — customer snapshot forwarded]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, alice.jensen@swiftcommerce.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Sudden latency spike across inference endpoints (prod)

Update — mitigation actions executed at 08:20 PT:

- Reduced per-request batching window from 60ms -> 20ms for checkout routes.
- Rerouted high-reliability traffic to dedicated warm pool (dedicated-14).
- Disabled an experimental KV-cache eviction policy rolled out yesterday (suspected correlation).

Telemetry shows p95 reduced from ~1.9s to ~420ms within 6 minutes of the change; 5xxs dropped to ~0.4%. No further errors after 08:35 PT.

I’m drafting a short runbook for rollback and a timeline of the config change. Will attach the runbook and raw telemetry in the RCA draft.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior SRE — Redwood Inference

Attachment: mitigation-runbook-v1.md (md)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: alice.jensen@swiftcommerce.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Sudden latency spike across inference endpoints (prod)

Alice — thanks for the quick report and patience. For the 11:00 exec readout I will cover:

- What happened (succinct timeline).
- Customer impact (quantified).
- Controls triggered / why backup pool engaged.
- Short-term mitigations and validation.
- Next steps: full RCA by 05/19 EOD, follow-up demo of improved SLOs, and proposal for a credits/financial remediation discussion.

Laura — can you prep the high-level impact slide (revenue estimate for the 25-minute window) and confirm who from legal/finance we should brief if customer requests credit?

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
From: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@swiftcommerce.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: pm@swiftcommerce.com, oncall@swiftcommerce.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Sudden latency spike across inference endpoints (prod)

Thanks Grace — that covers it for the readout. We do want a documented RCA and proposed remediation by EOD tomorrow (05/19). For remediation: SwiftCommerce will likely request a 10% credit for the impacted day unless we can demonstrate preventive controls and agreed follow-through that materially reduce recurrence risk. Please keep legal copied if remediation becomes financial.

Alice
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: alice.jensen@swiftcommerce.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, legal@swiftcommerce.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: SwiftCommerce RCA, corrective actions, and closure plan

Alice — attaching the finalized RCA and a closure plan per our commitments. Summary below:

Summary (TL;DR):
- Primary root cause: a recent KV-cache eviction policy change (deploy on 05/17) caused increased cache churn under SwiftCommerce's access pattern, amplifying tail latency when combined with a short-lived tokenization microburst. The experimental eviction interacted poorly with request batching heuristics, causing higher GPU scheduling contention for checkout routes.

Corrective actions (owner / ETA):
- Revert experimental eviction policy; implement canary + pressure metrics before re-enabling (Owner: Marcus Lin / ETA: 05/20 09:00 PT) — completed.
- Introduce a pre-warm handshake and adaptive batching window for checkout flows (Owner: Rishi Malhotra / ETA: 06/04) — in plan.
- Add route-level SLA monitoring and automated fallback to warm pool at 95th percentile breach (Owner: Grace O'Connor / ETA: 06/10) — design review scheduled.
- Run monthly chaotic-synthetic tests for top-10 priority customers (Owner: Aditya Rao / ETA: 06/15) — onboarding plan attached.

Attachments: swift-rca-draft-20270519.docx (docx), mitigation-runbook-v1.md (md)

Financial remediation: we propose a 7% credit for 2027-05-18 (calculated from lost conversions and gross transaction value). We are open to discussion and have included the math in the attached slide.

Closure asks: please confirm acceptance of the RCA and the remediation package by EOD 05/24 so we can schedule follow-up implementation checkpoints.

Thanks and apologies again for the disruption — we’ll follow through on the commitments above and share weekly status until all actions are closed.

Best,
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
